findings.title: Pause, Delete, and Silence actions are broken or hidden in the alert list view when `rulerRule` is undefined
findings.body:
`AlertRuleMenu` and `RuleActionsButtons.V2` compute abilities (`canPause`, `canDelete`, `canSilence`) using `promRule` via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` when `rulerRule` is omitted in the alert list view, but the menu items and handlers still gate on `rulerRule`:

1. **Pause** (`AlertRuleMenu.tsx:123`): gated by `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) && ...`, so the Pause menu item is never rendered when `rulerRule` is undefined.
2. **Delete** (`AlertRuleMenu.tsx:165`): gated by `canDelete && rulerRule`, so the Delete menu item is never rendered in the list view when `rulerRule` is undefined (even though `RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:99` only needs `identifier` and `groupIdentifier` in `showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)`).
3. **Silence** (`AlertRuleMenu.tsx:126` & `RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:104`): the "Silence notifications" menu item is rendered because `canSilence` is true, but clicking it does nothing because `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` in `RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:104` is gated by `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`.

As a result, Grafana-managed rules in the alert list view cannot be paused or deleted from the menu, and clicking "Silence notifications" silently fails to open the drawer.

findings.title: Missing React `key` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem` in `FilterView`
findings.body: When replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map(...)`, the `key={key}` prop was dropped. Rendering list items without a `key` causes React warnings and can lead to incorrect component state reuse when rules are appended or re-rendered.

findings.title: Grafana-managed recording rules lose `ModifyExport` ability when checked via `promRule`
findings.body: In `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` (line 268), `AlertRuleAction.ModifyExport` is `[isGrafanaManagedAlertRule, exportAllowed]`, where `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule` is `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)` (true for both Grafana alerting and recording rules). In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` (line 324), it is set to `[isAlertingRule, exportAllowed]`, where `isAlertingRule` is `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`, which is false for recording rules (`PromRuleType.Recording`). Moreover, when `rule` is `undefined` (i.e. `skipToken` is passed), `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` still returns `[true, ...]` for `View` and `Explore` and `[true, createPerm]` for `Duplicate` because `MaybeSupported` defaults to `AlwaysSupported` even when `rule` is `undefined`.
